Game Overview

In Cat Chef and Broccoli, the core idea is straightforward: join the thrilling escape of a plucky broccoli pursued by a determined cat chef. Navigate perilous obstacles and outwit clichés like tempting cookies to reach safety. With retro graphics and engaging challenges, timing and agility are your best allies in this delightful adventure. Can you outsmart the chase?
